mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (id, role_name, role_code, scope_type, scope_org_ids, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{roleName}, #{roleCode}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeOrgIds}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET role_name = COALESCE(#{roleName}, role_name), role_code = COALESCE(#{roleCode}, role_code), scope_type = COALESCE(#{scopeType}, scope_type), scope_org_ids = COALESCE(#{scopeOrgIds}, scope_org_ids), description = COALESCE(#{description}, description), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_role ORDER BY created_at DESC
